rationale: Model quality degrades with ABSOLUTE context size, not with percent of the window. On a 1M window, a percent-based ladder (compact at 70% = 700k) keeps agents reasoning in a degraded zone far too long. Pin compaction to absolute tokens so every agent stays in its sharpest zone, hands-free.
vehicle: _relay/BATON.md Pi-format checkpoint (Goal/Constraints/Progress/Key-Decisions/Next-Steps/Critical-Context; preserve exact file paths, function names, error messages)
steps: 150k (compact_at): summarize every COMPLETED wave/phase to durable files (STATE.json, briefs, reports); drop the resolved transcript; keep PLAN.md + open work + BATON.
200k (handoff_at): hard stop — write the Pi-format BATON checkpoint and continue fresh from it. Never carry a transcript past 200k.
